def: to rend apart; reflexively, to separate

occurrences.text: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
